description: This file defines the NottableStringMultiMap class, a data structure for managing a map with NottableString keys and values, including methods for containment checks, key analysis, and internal data management within the mockserver project.

classes.name: NottableStringMultiMap
classes.description: A map-like data structure supporting matching and subset operations with NottableString keys and values, used within the mockserver framework.

methods.name: NottableStringMultiMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing the map with entries or key-value arrays, setting up regex matcher and key match style.

methods.name: getKeyMatchStyle
methods.description: Returns the key match style used in the map.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if the current map contains all entries of a subset map, with different matching strategies.

methods.name: allKeysNotted
methods.description: Returns true if all keys in the map are 'not' keys.

methods.name: allKeysOptional
methods.description: Returns true if all keys in the map are optional.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all values associated with a key, supporting regex matching.

methods.name: entryList
methods.description: Returns a list of all entries in the map.
